body: PR #1076 residuals: (1) ticket worktree head is not recorded on release or completion (V1-1588); (2) defects harvest from Playwright or CI reports is not implemented (V1-1593); (3) CLI pre-parse know-how screen ignores declared values, screening only at apply time (V1-1602); (4) reusing a ticket branch no longer descending from base only warns; (5) verbs live in corvint-tasks not Core because of the verb freeze.
title: ticket worktrees / defect register / know-how screen follow-ups (V1-1588/1593/1602 residuals)
